decision.reason: [ev-fe0fca386a7a] and PR #7317 [ev-80b40618a9f1][ev-b227e472a184] say a new Helm value webhook.extraEnv was added, which sets custom environment variables in the webhook Pod. The PR example uses a list of name/value entries [ev-be8ea0e84664], and the change is optional with no consequence if left unset. However, the deterministic values validator refuted "added" because it found webhook.extraEnv already in the v1.16.0 values. Its cited excerpts [ev-fdc96eee87bf][ev-717ddb6f40cd] only show a "# +docs:section=Global" header, not the webhook.extraEnv entries. To settle whether this is a 1.17.0 addition, we need the actual webhook.extraEnv content from both releases' values.yaml (for example, whether 1.16.0 had it only as a commented example).
